description: Says where a quote stands: priced, waiting on the person (with minutes left on the hold), booked (when, and with which tech), they said it was not them, or the hold ran out. Once booked, it also says whether the tech is on the way (with the minutes left while their phone shares the drive), arrived (and whether inside the time promised), finished, or the visit was cancelled, and the tech's state license with the board that checked it, when it is checked and in force. Use it after hold_time, or later, to tell the person how it went. Sends nothing.
name: booking_status

visit.description: The booked visit as it stands now: its time, its tech, and what has happened since the yes.

drive.description: While the tech is on the way with their phone sharing: the minutes left on the drive, the same the person's own tracking page shows. estimated is true when the phone went quiet and the minutes follow the road's pace. Absent otherwise; arrival ends it.

now.description: Where the visit has got to, from the tech's own taps and the visit's close.

promise.description: The time promised now, and how the arrival measured against it: open (its time has not ended), kept (arrived inside it), early or late (by minutes), missed, canceled, or unrecorded.

annotations.title: Check a license with the state

description: Asks whether a US contractor or trade license number is in force, with the state board that licenses that work: the board's status, the holder's name as the board lists it, the license kind, its end date, whether it covers the work asked about, and the day the board said so. Use it when the person wants to know whether a shop or a technician is licensed, given the number. Some states license the work only by city or county, or not at all; then it says so and gives the state's own page, or each city's and county's own page in local_lists. When a shop on HandledIQ holds the license, in force, its record and booking door come with the answer. It gives license status only, never a phone, an address or an email. Side effects: none.

number.description: The license number as it is printed, like M-39874 or ROC 123456.

signed.description: Optional. true adds the shop's signed record, when a shop on HandledIQ holds the license, to check with verify_record. Leave it out unless the person asks for proof.

state.description: The state's two letters, like TX, AZ or DC.

trade.description: The work the license is for: hvac (heating and cooling), plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest (pest control), contractor (general building) or demolition.

name: check_license

checkable.description: false when the state has no license to check for this work, or no list HandledIQ can read by number.

in_force.description: null when the board's newest list is older than the day it ended.

local_lists.description: Where the state leaves the license to cities or counties: each one's own license page HandledIQ has, named by its place.

Use it when the person needs home service at a US house: heating and cooling, plumbing, electrical, roofing, pest control, junk removal, demolition and more. An empty list means no shop on HandledIQ takes that work near that ZIP yet. Sends nothing to anyone.
